A profile is a Data folder plus its own plugin list and saves. Your game settings are shared across profiles; your saves are not, because a save made with mods needs those mods.

Crash tests and logs. For bug reports.
The launcher follows your phone\'s language. The game has its own languages, so an English launcher with a game in another language is correct.
These switches exist to make the game fail in a known way, so a crash can be reported. They make the game slower and some will stop it loading. Nothing here touches your saves or your game files.

resources.string: Leave something out of the picture
Skips the hidden Pip-Boy render during a load. Tests whether that warm-up is what crashes.
Turns off the outline pass around V.A.T.S. targets. Tests whether that extra camera crashes.
The Khronos layer checks every GPU call and logs misuse. Much slower.
Also checks GPU work ordering. Needs the layer above, and does nothing while it is off.
Also instruments shaders. Very slow, and a load may never finish. Needs the layer above.
Marks every render step, so a GPU hang can name the step that died.
GPU breadcrumbs inside the transparent pass
Marks each group of see-through draws, so a hang there can name the group instead of the whole pass. Needs the breadcrumbs above. Much slower.
Smoke and dust keep hard edges where they meet a wall, and the shader stops reading the depth of the scene. Tests whether that read crashes.
Draws no smoke, dust, sparks or blood mist. They are still simulated, just not drawn.
Places no bullet holes and no blood splatter. Shots and their damage are unchanged.
Draws no shimmering air over the desert. One screen-wide pass fewer.
Logs every controller event. Big logs.
Logs contain your device model, folder paths, file names and the name of your active profile. They contain no game data and no account details. Read them before you share them.
Nothing on this screen touches your saves, your plugin list or your game files.
